Context: Part Reports necessary-

## Part Reports necessary-  
- (i) if the official is transferred to the control of another Reporting Officer in the same or other office during the year. Reports are to be written by the respective Reporting Officers for the relevant periods.
- (ii) if the Reporting Officer is transferred during the year. He should write APARs for all the staff under his control up to the date of his transfer, within 3-5 weeks of his transfer.
